messages:
maria: Quick sync — SignetAI wants Redwood hosted runtime listed on GCP Marketplace with a co-announce alongside HelixSI. They also asked for a BYOW hosting SKU. Need legal on redistribution terms, product on packaging, eng on artifacts. Launch target: 2026-05-12. Thoughts?

devin: @maria need license clarity first. Do the model weights allow SaaS hosting + marketplace distribution? Ask SignetAI for the model license file and a reseller addendum. If weights are CC-BY/Apache it's ok; if there's a non-commercial clause we can't host. Also request export-control questionnaire and list of training data sources.

ashok: For product — prefer two SKUs: Hosted (Redwood runtime + Signet weights hosted) and BYOW (customer uploads weights + Signet license acceptance). BYOW needs an explicit TOU acceptance UI. We should also offer a quantized-hosted variant we maintain. Permission gating: license flag + enterprise addendum for Dedicated.

julia: GTM: need embargo window and PR owners. If HelixSI co-announces, coordinate partner quoting and joint assets. Who will own the announcement comms and customer references? :eyes: 

sam: Engineering notes — GCP Marketplace packaging requires a marketplace.json, container image, and a public launch URL. Minimal checklist I'll stub:

```
- marketplace.json
- signed_license.pdf
- docker image (gcr.io/redwood/signet-runtime:tag)
- health endpoint: /v1/health
- billing metadata + SKU mapping
- KMS integration note
```

I'll start a stub repo and share link.

devin: Also need SLA draft and a data-flow diagram proving we don't persist PII. Add KMS/HSM requirement and tenant isolation options. Signet should sign a Use & Rights addendum (RBAC/TOA) confirming allowed redistribution and logging obligations.

maria: I'll request license + export questionnaire from Signet today and copy legal. @ashok can you sketch SKU mapping and UI gating? @julia propose embargo 2026-04-15 for internal review and 2026-05-12 public launch?

ashok: SKU mapping: hosted_standard | hosted_quant | byow_standard. Permission gates: license_ok && export_clear && partner_addendum_signed. I'll drop a short doc in the partnerships drive with example UI flows.

julia: Comms owners: Redwood PR + HelixSI comms lead. I'll draft two blurb options (developer-focused + enterprise-focused) and post for legal review.

announce-bot: Reminder — marketing embargo doc updated (doc id 3625007000).

maria: Thanks team. Devin please add required license checklist items in the thread. Sam post marketplace stub by EOD tomorrow. Reconvene Thu 10:00am PT. :thumbsup:
